name: insumer
description: Check what a wallet holds, with a signed yes or no. InsumerAPI wallet auth for AI agents: token balances, NFTs, EAS attestations, ERC-8004 agents and trust profiles across 37 chains, never the balance. Six skills plus the hosted MCP server at api.insumermodel.com/mcp.

interface.longDescription:
Ask ChatGPT things like "check if this wallet holds at least 100 USDC on Base", "does this wallet own an NFT from this collection", "is this wallet a registered ERC-8004 agent", "build a trust profile for this wallet", "verify this wallet attestation offline" or "what discount does this wallet get at this merchant". InsumerAPI answers each one with a signed yes or no: does this wallet satisfy this condition right now? The balance itself is never returned.

Conditions cover token balances, NFT ownership, EAS attestations (including Coinbase Verifications and Gitcoin Passport templates), Farcaster IDs, ERC-8004 agent registration and ERC-7710 delegations, across 37 chains: 31 EVM chains plus Solana, XRP Ledger, Bitcoin, Tron, Stellar and Sui. Send a wallet address and up to ten conditions in one request. A wallet trust profile runs 145 checks across 27 chains in nine dimensions and reports what is held or not held, with no score and no opinion.

Every response carries an ECDSA signature and a post-quantum companion signature (ML-DSA-65), a hash of the evaluated condition, and the block it was read at. Anyone can check a result without calling InsumerAPI again, using the open-source insumer-verify package on npm and PyPI.

This plugin connects to the hosted InsumerAPI MCP server, which needs no account and no key. It serves ten tools: the public signing keys, condition attestation, compliance templates, wallet trust profiles (single and batch), the merchant and token directories, a free discount check, and discount-code validation. The tools that produce signed results share one free daily allowance across all users of the hosted server; once it is used up, calls are declined until 00:00 UTC with a pointer to a free API key. The six included skills cover the same work through the REST API with your own key, which gives you your own allowance, key and credit management, and the merchant tools.

Not for: exact balances, portfolio values, price data, sending transactions, or trading. InsumerAPI holds no secrets, requires no identity, issues no static credentials, and stores no wallet addresses or conditions from verification requests. It is condition-based access infrastructure, and wallet auth is how it works: read the wallet's on-chain state, evaluate it against the condition, sign the answer.

Documentation: https://insumermodel.com/developers/
OpenAPI: https://insumermodel.com/openapi.yaml
Source for the MCP server (MIT): https://github.com/insumerapi/mcp-server-insumer
